consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, which EVALUATES the yes/no of whether the delivery quest's required item quantity is satisfied (the value the HUD surfaces but the quest-turn-in consumes).
scope: items reachable via the player's crafting_inventory() (own carried items PLUS nearby reachable items), not just carried items.
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — its body queries u.crafting_inventory() and returns has_amount(item_id,count) (with a charges fallback), i.e. the engine-COMPUTED completion predicate.
divergence: The required item sits on an adjacent reachable tile but is not carried: crafting_inventory() includes it so is_complete returns true, while a carried-items-only re-derivation (write_carried_items reach) returns false — the wrong-reach answer fails the quest that the engine considers complete.
